description:
USE THIS TOOL WHEN discovering HMRC GOV.UK guidance on a topic.

Returns official-search titles, URLs, descriptions, and published dates;
descriptions do not establish the contents of a cited page. AFTER calling,
use hmrc_get_manual_page when a result is an HMRC internal-manual URL.
Source: GOV.UK's HMRC-filtered content search API.

limit.description: Maximum guidance results to return (1–25). Passed to the GOV.UK search count param.

query.description: Search query for HMRC guidance, e.g. 'VAT digital services', 'R&D tax relief SME'

name: hmrc_search_guidance

outputSchema.description:
Result of an HMRC guidance search on GOV.UK.

Wraps the list of matching guidance documents with search metadata so
the LLM client sees a real nested object on the wire rather than a
stringified JSON blob.

query.description: The search query that was run

results.description: Matching HMRC guidance pages. Each entry's `summary` is capped per the max_summary_chars input parameter.

items.description: A single HMRC guidance document search result.

summary.description: Brief summary of the guidance content

updated.description: Date the guidance was last updated

total.description: Number of guidance documents returned in this call

title: Search HMRC Guidance
